scripts.cap:add: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:open: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.cap:release: npm run verify && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.cap:debug: npm run verify && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
